---
title: "Patch supplementary Manhattan plot"
---

## Overview

Patch the Manhattan plot (Supplementary Fig. 5) for manuscript publication: apply consistent theme sizing and export as high-resolution PNG.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

# ggtext loaded via .Rprofile dependency chain; no extra packages needed
source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()
```

## Load Plot Object

Load the pre-generated Manhattan plot RDS.

```{r}
#| label: load-plot

fig_manhattan <- read_rds(
 here("dmp/output/manhattan_plot_dementia_relevance.rds")
)
```

## Patch Supplementary Fig 5 (Manhattan)

Adjust legend text sizes and rescale geometric elements for publication column width.

```{r}
#| label: patch-fig5

fig_manhattan_patched <- fig_manhattan +
 theme(
   legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
   legend.title = element_text(size = 11)
 )
fig_manhattan_patched <- rescale_layer_params(fig_manhattan_patched, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)
```

## Save Patched Figure

Export as high-resolution PNG using `grDevices::png` (not `ragg::agg_png`) because the plot uses plotmath `%*%` which ragg renders as a centered dot instead of the multiplication sign.

```{r}
#| label: save-figure

fs::dir_create(here("dmp/patch_figures/output"))

ggsave(
 here("dmp/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_5_manhattan.png"),
 fig_manhattan_patched,
 width = 6.5,
 height = 9.0,
 dpi = 600,
 bg = "white",
 device = grDevices::png
)

message("Patched Manhattan plot saved to dmp/patch_figures/output/")
```

## Verify Output

List output files with sizes and modification times.

```{r}
#| label: verify-output

output_files <- fs::dir_ls(here("dmp/patch_figures/output"), glob = "*.png")
file_info <- fs::file_info(output_files)
file_info |>
 select(path, size, modification_time) |>
 mutate(path = basename(path))
```
